channel.description: Latest articles from Andalusia Star News (andalusiastarnews.com)

item.title: Opp advances to host Area Championship game
item.description: Opp boys top Bullock County to earn home Class 4A Area 4 title game vs New Brockton; Lady Bobcats secure first playoff win in four years before falling in semifinals.

item.title: Pleasant Home enjoys victories on Senior Night
item.description: Pleasant Home celebrates Senior Night with dominant girls and boys basketball wins over Emmanuel Christian, highlighted by a 74-11 and 75-30 sweep and recognition of standout seniors.

item.title: LBW hosts Stallings Documentary screening
item.description: LBW Community College screened “Do Right – The Stallings Standard,” highlighting coach Gene Stallings’ football legacy and advocacy for people with special needs.

item.title: First Responder Spotlight: Odom
item.description: With 35 years in law enforcement and more than 20 in narcotics work, Mark Odom is running for Covington County sheriff on a platform of accountability, discipline, and integrity.

item.title: Smith inducted into Leadership Hall of Fame
item.description: Mayor Earl Johnson inducts retiring PowerSouth CEO Gary Smith into Andalusia Leadership Hall of Fame, honoring his decades of service and role in growing the energy cooperative.

item.title: Small Cakes reopens under new owner
item.description: Small Cakes Cupcakery in Andalusia reopens under new owner Kristel Barlow, offering signature cupcakes, homemade ice cream and custom cakes Monday–Saturday.

item.title: RLS promotes Windham to head football coach
item.description: Red Level School promotes defensive coordinator Griffin Windham to head football coach for 2026, as he aims to build on a solid foundation and deepen ties with the community.

item.title: RODEO CROWNS QUEENS
item.description: Trinite Halaya Bryant was crowned Miss Opp Rattlesnake Rodeo 2026 at the Feb. 7 pageant, joining new Tiny, Little, Junior and Teen queens ahead of the 65th annual Rodeo.

item.title: Bulldogs look forward to post season
item.description: At 14-5 after a key win over Greenville, Andalusia’s young Bulldogs regroup from midseason struggles and head into Saturday’s sub-regional still awaiting an opponent.
